correctness.rationale: For every fixed fully supported nonuniform q-ary law, exact cell increments u=q^(-n),v=product(p_digit) give D_n=2-L_n=E_U phi(exp(S_n)). Since M’(0)=-D(U||P)<0 and M’(1)=D(P||U)>0, strict convexity fixes unique s* in (0,1), rho<1 and centered positive-variance tilted increments. The precise change of measure D_n=rho^n E_pi g(S_n) and per-step gain G_n=rho^n E_pi psi(S_n) follow from the finite formula. Strict concavity of phi and nonuniform weights makes psi positive. g and psi have exponential tails, allowing classical Stone/local lattice LLTs and positive uniformly summable periodic profiles. Explicit integration by parts evaluates int(g)=2^(s*-1) B((s*+1)/2,1-s*)/s*; int(psi)=(1-rho)int(g), and the arithmetic shifts give H(theta)=A(theta)-rho A(theta+a). Thus both D_n and G_n have the asserted sharp rho^n/sqrt(n) laws. Independently recomputed 7-file tree and verified finite levels with direct and multinomial methods, Chernoff tilts, beta quadrature and periodic gains. Uniform p and zero digit weights are correctly excluded; finite numerics are not a proof of the infinite theorem.
